items.name: Flashlight
items.description: Mom's heavy yellow flashlight from the junk drawer. Good for dark places.

items.name: Glass Shard
items.description: A piece of the living room window. It was lying on the porch, not the carpet.

items.name: Brass Key Tag
items.description: Stamped MERCER — SPARE. It hung on the spare key. The key itself is gone.

items.name: Pale Gold Feather
items.description: Warm to the touch, and faintly glowing in the dark. No bird grows feathers like this.
